variants.prompt: REFORM CAMERA ANGLE: On a private, rooftop balcony at dusk, she stands with her back to the camera, gazing out over the Barcelona skyline. The black leather jacket and tight red dress are now a revealing, high-cut black swimsuit that accentuates her toned physique. Her striking amber eyes, highlighted by smoky eye makeup, gaze out at the cityscape, a sly, playful smile playing on her full lips. A DSLR camera, positioned low and looking up, captures her from behind, her raven-black hair cascading down her back and the subtle curves of her backside emphasized as she leans forward. The blurred city lights create a romantic, dreamlike ambiance in the shallow focus shot.
